case_title: TENNI ENRICO DBA VALTELLINA AUTOMOBILI VS WINDSHIELDS AMERICA INC.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,991.10 FILED BY TENNI ENRICO DBA VALTELLINA AUTOMOBILI AS TO DEFENDANT WINDSHIELDS AMERICA INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-15-1994 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 05
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT WINDSHIELDS AMERICA INC.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TENNI ENRICO DBA VALTELLINA AUTOMOBILI IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT WINDSHIELDS AMERICA INC. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
